limits: PR state checked only for PRs headed from the fork. PRs by other authors on the same ticket were not searched (phase H2 QA).
owner_excluded not evaluated: needs Jira reporter and assignee for each key.
Fix-version citations for close-fixed were not checked (phase H2 QA).
Rev4 rule: bugs are barred from the four closure families only; ping-stale is open to bugs. Critical and Blocker are barred from all families. Keys with no metadata row are not family-eligible.
